description: Adaptive Surface 0.10.0: bounded quad carriers, inverted corner and stacked-pair topology, donor-native transition profiles and offline atlas migration; includes 0.9.6 constructor-time single-JAR world-pack bootstrap.
changes: Choose an equivalent triangle basis whose whole carrier quad remains in the voxel, then pack native voxel-axis UVs in the existing 256x256 HD atlas
Add U1-U14 vertically mirrored solids and collision boxes; resolve undersides and stacked pairs from immutable terrain/anchors
Copy only native Group/TransitionTexture/TransitionToGroups/TransitionToTag; split identical-image aliases when native transition profiles differ
Retain old P/Q IDs and remap old Q atlases before asset loading; preserve previous model paths for fallback archives
Prepare and enable per-world asset pack in plugin constructor before AssetModule setup; no external publisher or installer required
advantages: Bounded geometry and unchanged per-material atlas capacity
disadvantages: Visual acceptance of custom-model native blending and tint remains pending in client
Compact cached images cannot regain missing detail
Native APIs and renderer behavior require revalidation on game updates
test_results: Gradle check/build passed 257162 assertions including atlas migration
42 shapes, 51450 collision-height samples, whole-quad bounds verified; 702 hidden helpers and one creative item
Three isolated native browser-install boots passed fresh creation, requested material and disabled-pack recovery
Two native boots placed underside/corner pairs in four rotations and verified eight states after reopening
Isolated real-cache migration boot loaded 75 appearances / 958 aliases with zero runtime registrations
Existing saves staged at 65/61 materials and 5242880/4980736 atlas pixels
